text:
Happy Saturday! It's a frosty, crisp start in the upper 20s, with maybe a few high clouds around sunrise, so give the windshield a minute. High pressure is parked right on top of us, which means sunshine all day and hardly a breath of wind. The afternoon climbs to near 56, a touch warmer than most of the week so far, then tonight stays clear and chilly, around 35. No rain anywhere close, and there's still a little color left on the trees, so it's a good day for a walk.

Sunday is even nicer: sunny and warmer, near 61, though the models run from the upper 50s to the low 60s and I'd lean toward the warm end. A light south breeze picks up in the afternoon as the high slides east. A cold front comes through Monday afternoon and evening and could squeeze out a stray shower, but the air ahead of it is so dry that I'd bet on staying dry. The real change is Tuesday, when highs struggle to the mid 40s. Enjoy the weekend: a jacket for the morning, and you can shed it by afternoon.
